title: Method for the synthesis of flavonoid nitrogen mustard derivatives
author: Song, Yu, et al.

steps.title: Alkylate genistein with dibromoalkane
steps.instruction: Dissolve genistein (1 mmol, 1 eq) in 50 mL anhydrous acetone, add potassium carbonate (2 mmol, 2 eq) and stir 15 min at room temperature. Slowly add 1,2‑dibromoethane, 1,3‑dibromopropane, or 1,4‑dibromobutane (10 mmol, 10 eq). Heat the mixture to reflux for 8 h, then evaporate the solvent under reduced pressure. Wash the crude product sequentially with 5 mL petroleum ether (3 ×) and 10 mL distilled water (3 ×), filter under reduced pressure, dry the residue and purify by silica‑gel column chromatography using MeOH/CH₂Cl₂ (1:60) to afford compounds 2a‑c.

substeps.instruction: Stir genistein, acetone, and K₂CO₃ 15 min at rt.
Wash with petroleum ether (5 mL ×3) then water (10 mL ×3).

steps.title: Alkylate chrysin with dibromoalkane
steps.instruction: Dissolve chrysin (1 mmol, 1 eq) in 50 mL anhydrous acetone, add potassium carbonate (4 mmol, 4 eq) and stir 15 min at room temperature. Slowly add 1,2‑dibromoethane, 1,3‑dibromopropane, or 1,4‑dibromobutane (10 mmol, 10 eq). Heat to reflux for 8 h, then remove the solvent under vacuum. Wash the residue with petroleum ether and distilled water successively, filter under reduced pressure, dry and purify by silica‑gel column chromatography using CH₂Cl₂ to obtain compounds 6a‑c.

substeps.instruction: Stir chrysin, acetone, and K₂CO₃ 15 min at rt.
Wash with petroleum ether then distilled water.

steps.title: React genistein alkylates with diethanolamine
steps.instruction: Dissolve each compound 2a‑c (1 mmol, 1 eq) in 50 mL acetonitrile, add diethanolamine (10 mmol, 10 eq) and reflux at 85 °C for 48 h. Cool to room temperature to induce crystallization, filter under reduced pressure, wash the solid with water, dry and purify by silica‑gel column chromatography using MeOH/CH₂Cl₂ (1:40) to afford compounds 3a‑c.

substeps.instruction: Cool to rt, crystallize, filter, wash with water.

steps.title: React chrysin alkylates with diethanolamine
steps.instruction: Dissolve each compound 6a‑c (1 mmol, 1 eq) in 50 mL acetonitrile, add diethanolamine (10 mmol, 10 eq) and reflux for 48 h. Cool to room temperature to crystallize, filter under reduced pressure, wash with water, dry and purify by silica‑gel column chromatography using MeOH/CH₂Cl₂ (1:60) to obtain compounds 7a‑c.

substeps.instruction: Cool to rt, crystallize, filter, wash with water.

steps.title: Convert genistein amides to acid chlorides
steps.instruction: Dissolve each compound 3a‑c (1 mmol, 1 eq) in 50 mL CH₂Cl₂, add thionyl chloride (SOCl₂, 8 mmol, 8 eq) and reflux for 48 h. Remove the solvent with a rotary evaporator, dry the residue and purify by silica‑gel column chromatography using MeOH/CH₂Cl₂ (1:60) to afford compounds 4a‑c.

steps.title: Convert chrysin amides to acid chlorides
steps.instruction: Dissolve each compound 7a‑c (1 mmol, 1 eq) in 50 mL CH₂Cl₂, add thionyl chloride (SOCl₂, 8 mmol, 8 eq) and reflux for 48 h. Remove the solvent with a rotary evaporator, dry the residue and purify by silica‑gel column chromatography using MeOH/CH₂Cl₂ (1:100) to obtain compounds 8a‑c.
